english.title: Have custody / control of apparatus in contravention of a wireless telegraphy restriction order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse had apparatus in your custody or control in contravention of a restriction order issued under section 62(5) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006
english.legislation: Contrary to section 66(1)(b) and (3) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes:
(i) Section 107 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 provides for proceedings and enforcement regarding this offence.
(ii) Section 110 of the Act provides for criminal liability of company directors, managers, etc.
(iii) The Wireless Telegraphy (Fixed Penalty) Regulations 2011, (In force 01/10/2011), introduces a £100-00p fixed penalty charge for summary only offences under the Act, as from that date. This regime does not include offences relating to illegal broadcasting (pirate radio).
english.standardstatementoffacts:

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed Penalty charge of £100-00p (in force from 01/10/2011).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
